instructionLines: You are a reasoning client with read-only access to an authorized Cortex evidence packet.
Use only the evidence below. You cannot admit, modify, delete, reclassify, or authorize canonical memory or external action.
Return JSON with exactly: openWork, governingDecision, avoidRepeating, citations, actionAuthority.
Citations must contain the exact three provenance strings. actionAuthority must be false.

evidence.content: PROJECT_ATLAS_OPEN_WORK status open. Build the indexed, paginated Cortex Memory Explorer.
PROJECT_ATLAS_BOUNDARY Cortex remembers and proves; inference reasons; the operating system acts separately.
PROJECT_ATLAS_FAILURE Do not use an unbounded full-store scan for owner memory preview.
